Strong match - the left side shows the white-gray dusty appearance on soybean leaves, matching the test image. Let me check Downy Mildew as an alternative.
Downy mildew shows yellow spots, not the full white coating. Not a match. Let me check more classes.
Frogeye shows discrete spots, not the uniform white coating. Let me check two more classes.

Excellent. The second Powdery Mildew reference (Soybean_Dise_20.jpg) is a near-perfect match to the test image - the same white/gray dusty powdery coating covering the entire leaf surface.

**Summary of observations:**
- Test image: Uniform white-gray powdery coating on leaf surfaces across the canopy, especially visible on lower/inner leaves
- Powdery_Mildew ref 1 (Dise_14): Field-level view showing exact same whitish-gray canopy appearance
- Powdery_Mildew ref 2 (Dise_20): Close-up showing white powdery mycelium coating on leaf surface - identical to test
- All other classes (Downy mildew, Septoria, Cercospora, Rust, Frogeye, Bacterial Blight) showed discrete spots/lesions, not the uniform powdery coating
